To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we identified 35 Thai patients with germline mutations of the VHL, SDHB, RET, and SDHD.
we have identified the most frequent mutations in patients with VHL and paraganglioms, and that these mutations correlate with disease phenotypes.
the genotype-phenotype correlations in patients with germline mutations of VHL, SDHB, SDHD, and RET genes are similar to those previously described in the Western population.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the genotype and phenotype correlation between the VHL, SDHB, RET, and SDHD gene mutations and their clinical presentations.
the genotype-phenotype correlations of VHL disease, MEN2, and paragangliomatosis.
the genotype-phenotype correlations of the four most common hereditary cancer syndromes in Thailand.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the clinical phenotypes of patients with germline mutations of the VHL, MEN2, and SDHB/SDHD genes are similar to that reported in other populations.
genotype-phenotype correlations are important to predict the risk of developing tumors, to plan appropriate surveillance, to identify the most appropriate treatment, and to determine prognosis.
genotype-phenotype correlations in Southeast Asian population are not much different from those reported in Western population.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
genotype-phenotype correlations are important in clinical management of patients with germline mutations.
we have a good knowledge about the clinical presentation and genetic mutation spectrum for patients with VHL disease, MEN2, and paragangliomata in Thailand.
the most frequent mutations of RET, SDHB and VHL in Thailand are p.Cys634X, p.Arg46X, and p.Trp88Stop, respectively.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the genotype-phenotype correlations of VHL, MEN2, and paragangliomatosis are similar to the data reported from Western populations, but the frequency of p.Cys634X RET mutation in MEN2 is higher than that of the Western population.
the genetic testing of VHL and RET genes is important for early diagnosis of these diseases.
the genetic testing is a powerful tool in the management of hereditary tumors.
